answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The cedar lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the jetty is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the zephyr of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, held in escrow until finality, no identity may audit its own recruit. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
